selected_candidates.speaker: client
selected_candidates.text:
Hey! I wanted to send over the vision for the website.

The goal is to build a national brand website for SHATTER HOUSE that can support multiple locations and future franchise growth.

Main Website:
https://shatterhouseusa.example

For the visual direction, use a clean, modern, mobile-friendly design with simplicity similar to RageWorks USA. The branding should combine black, purple, and white with large images, generous spacing, and easy navigation.

Homepage Sections:

Hero Banner
Location Selector
Rage Rooms
Axe Throwing
Splatter Room
Corporate Events
Birthday Parties
Reviews
FAQ
Contact

The homepage should immediately show visitors what we offer and allow them to select their location.

Current Locations:

Linden Falls
Port Averly
Ridgehaven

Give every location its own dedicated page while keeping the design and branding consistent across all locations. The website should be built so future locations can be added easily without redesigning the site.

Future examples:

Mesa Crest
Highpoint
Riverbend
Franchise Locations

The overall feel should be a national entertainment brand, not a local business website.

llm_evaluation.reason: The task materially revises the master domain, location routing, reusable location structure, visual direction, and cross-location branding while introducing mobile and homepage requirements. History must be reconciled to avoid retaining the obsolete domain, separate-site routing, or prior location-branding strategy, and the resulting national master-site design is concrete and verifiable. The supplied events treat these changes as resolved updates, so no material clarification decision remains.

selected_candidates.speaker: client
selected_candidates.text:
Ridgehaven will operate on its own Wix account and must remain separate from Harbor Valley Shatter House.

Ridgehaven needs its own:

Bookings
Customer database
Analytics
Memberships
Gift cards
Payment processing
Staff access
Payouts

I want customers to feel like they are visiting the same SHATTER HOUSE brand, but the backend operations need to stay completely separate.

For now, Ridgehaven should be built as a “Coming Soon” location.

Ridgehaven Page Layout:

Hero Banner
Rage Rooms
Axe Throwing
Splatter Room
Corporate Events
Birthday Parties
FAQ
Photo Gallery
Contact Information
VIP Email Signup

Buttons:

Join VIP List
Opening Soon

Build the page so that once Ridgehaven opens, we only need to turn on booking and update the photos without redesigning anything. The Ridgehaven page should then become the template for future locations.

llm_evaluation.reason: The task concretely extends prior location architecture: Ridgehaven must use its own Wix backend while the master site remains booking-free, existing booking and analytics isolation gain Ridgehaven-specific behavior, booking stays off during the coming-soon phase, and Ridgehaven becomes the future-location template. History is material for preserving the master/location boundary and accumulated template strategy; incorrect reconstruction could activate booking too early, place it on the master site, or mix location operations. No material ambiguity remains, and the requested page and configuration changes are verifiable.

selected_candidates.text: The Shatter House USA site should be the home page where visitors find the location they want to book from, with a location-selection menu that leads to either website. Also, just list the activities like you have.

selected_candidates.text: Moving only the domain won’t resolve this, because all the settings and subscriptions are stored in the other accounts.
